answer_2.quote: We report raw agreement and kappa coefficient (with standard deviations)... We also report the accuracies of the two classifiers which are proved to be quite similar.

answer_3.quote: We repeated the experiments ... using a LLM rater. The LLM rater receives the top 3 concepts ... and makes a decision by computing cosine similarity between its embedding of each class name to its embedding of the textual representation of the 3 concepts.
methods: Cosine similarity between class name embeddings and concept embeddings

answer_4.quote: We have designed a human experiment with the goal of testing the human understandability... 3 graduate students were used for rating. The instruction to the human raters was: "A document belongs to one of two classes. The document is described by the following 3 key phrases (topics): 1, 2, and 3. To which of the two classes do you think the document belongs to?"
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to assign the document to one of two classes based on the three presented concepts.
